events.title: Ocean Film Festival Tour 2026
events.location: The J, Noosa Junction, Noosa Heads
events.description: Experience the best in ocean adventure, surfing, conservation, and natural wonder with this annual touring film festival, ideal for outdoor and ocean lovers, and a social crowd.

events.title: Ocean Film Festival Tour 2026
events.location: The J, Noosa Junction, Noosa Heads
events.description: A second screening of the popular annual touring film festival showcasing ocean adventure, surfing, conservation, and natural wonder, attracting a warm social crowd.

events.title: Silent Film Screening with Live Organ
events.description: Step back in time at the historic Majestic Theatre for a silent film screening, brought to life with a live organist, offering a unique early 20th-century cinema experience.

events.title: Turn Kitchen Scraps into Garden Gold (Mulch & Compost Workshop)
events.description: A free, hands-on community workshop by Sunshine Coast Libraries, teaching practical skills for making mulch and compost from kitchen scraps to enrich your garden.

events.title: Turn a Tote into Wearable Art (Fabric Painting Workshop)
events.description: Unleash your creativity in this free, hands-on fabric painting workshop, where you'll learn techniques to transform a plain tote bag into a unique piece of wearable art.

events.title: Dive into the History of Local Fishing Spots (Going Coastal)
events.description: An intellectually engaging local history program exploring the past of Sunshine Coast's fishing spots, perfect for curious minds interested in regional heritage and place-making.

events.title: Calling All Little Scientists – Butterfly Garden Insect Survey
events.description: Join a hands-on science and nature event where participants learn how scientists study insects, setting up survey lines and observing in the new Butterfly Garden.

events.title: Historians Tell All – Uncover the Region's Hidden History
events.description: Two local experts share insights into the Sunshine Coast's hidden history, offering an intimate and intellectually stimulating community talk for curious locals.

events.title: Lind Lane Theatre — Annual General Meeting
events.description: Attend the AGM of Nambour's community theatre; a welcoming entry point for members and those interested in engaging with this small, intimate creative community.

events.title: Melbourne Comedy Festival Roadshow
events.description: Enjoy a night of top-tier stand-up with a curated line-up of Australian and international comedians as the Melbourne International Comedy Festival Roadshow tours through Caloundra (18+).

events.title: Sunshine Coast Symphony Orchestra — Symphonic Horizons
events.description: Embark on a musical journey with the SCSO, featuring pieces capturing the essence of various places, including the premiere of Clifford Bradley's 'Sunshine Coast Symphony'.

events.title: Local Contemporary Art Prize 2026
events.description: This annual exhibition showcases contemporary visual art from emerging and established Sunshine Coast artists, offering a final week to explore local talent.

events.title: Local Student Art Prize 2026
events.description: A companion exhibition to the main art prize, featuring 2D works by up-and-coming student artists from the Sunshine Coast region, in its final week.

events.title: Glimpse Exhibition by Cécile Bell
events.description: This is the final week to view 'Glimpse', an exhibition by artist Cécile Bell, displayed at Maroochydore Library during opening hours.

events.title: Intrigues — Bankfoot House Collection Exhibition
events.description: Explore 'Intrigues', a captivating exhibition showcasing objects from the historically significant Bankfoot House Collection, ideal for those interested in local heritage and material culture.

events.title: Majestic Theatre Pomona — Additional Event
events.description: The Majestic Theatre's events calendar lists a second event for May 16, which could be anything from a film theme night to a live performance. Check the website for details.
